player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round Rock-Paper-Scissors game.
Your goal is to win as many rounds as possible.
In each round, respond with one of: '[rock]', '[paper]', or '[scissors]'.
You may also use '[r]', '[p]', or '[s]' as shorthand.

invalid_move.wrong_format: حرڪت تسليم نه ڪئي وئي. استعمال ڪريو [rock]، [paper]، يا [scissors].

message.round_win: گول جو نتيجو: پليئر {winner} کٽي ٿو!

outcome.p0_wins: پليئر 0 سڀ کان وڌيڪ رائونڊ کٽي ورتو!
outcome.p1_wins: پليئر 1 سڀ کان وڌيڪ رائونڊ کٽي ويو!
